project_description: Simplify Go-LIP's upstream request-to-attempt execution pipeline after the turn-recv-terminal-ownership-simplification tranche establishes downstream lifetime-correct owners. Replace overlapping preparedRequest, routePlanState, attemptOpenParams pointer-out mutation, context-carried business mirrors, and mixed candidate planning/admission/open lifecycle with explicit typed phase products and freeze points. Preserve secure-session authority/order, route override snapshotting, metering/request-authority/billing admission, extension hooks/transforms, selector semantics, affinity, parallel and interleaved routing, capability/transport negotiation, usage authority, B2BUA allocation, error precedence, and backend-open behavior. Use one typed initial/retry pipeline, remove state-bag reconstruction and pointer-out outcome mutation, and hand opened attempts directly to the downstream ownership seam. Do not redesign selector grammar, billing/security domains, extension APIs, or introduce a generic stage engine/DI framework. This is architecture simplification tranche 2 and must be implemented chronologically after turn-recv-terminal-ownership-simplification is green.
